Let me verify: (x+3)(x+1) = x² + x + 3x + 3 = x² + 4x + 3. (x-1)(x-2) = x² - 2x - x + 2 = x² - 3x + 2. So x² + 4x + 3 = x² - 3x + 2 ⇒ 4x + 3 = -3x + 2 ⇒ 7x = -1 ⇒ x = -1/7. That still doesn't match.
